sentences.text: A referred specimen indicates that Diandongosaurus reached a total body length of 34 cm.
Diandongosaurus was first named by Qing-Hua Shang, Xiao-Chun Wu, and Chun Li in 2011.
The genus is known from the holotype specimen IVPP V 17761, which is a complete and articulated skeleton including the skull.
The fossils were discovered in the middle Triassic Lagerstätte of the Guanling Formation.
Diandongosaurus belongs to the parent group Eosauropterygia.
Diandongosaurus is classified within the class Reptilia.
Diandongosaurus lived during the lower Middle Triassic (Anisian age) in Yunnan Province, southwestern China.
